Dewy dogfood notes

This is a small converter. It handles code, emphasis and links.

Lists

  • first item
  • second with bold
  • third
  1. one
  2. two < three

Edge cases

Unclosed emphasis and a lone ` backtick.

Release notes

Version 0.3 adds faster builds & a --watch flag.

Changes

  • parser: handles a < b in guards
  • checker: no more spurious warnings
  • runtime: 2x faster maps

Upgrade steps

  1. back up config.toml
  2. run the migrate tool
  3. restart
Note: the old flag still works, but prints a warning.

dewy build --watch app.dewy
if x < 3 { y }
